newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya student in coma after police beating.
newsitem.headline: Kenya student in coma after police beating.

text.p: A student at the University of Nairobi was in a coma on Wednesday, according to hospital sources after he was beaten by police in front of reporters at the main campus.
F.W. Kinyanjui, a third-year arts student, was beaten on the back of the head by police while attempting to vacate the university closed by authorities on Wednesday.
"He is in a comatose state, his chances are so-so," said Agnes Karanu, assistant matron at Nairobi's Aga Khan hospital.

Riot police enforced the closure of the university after several days of clashes with students protesting against a new bill on student fees and police violence. Students say they support demands by opposition-backed groups pressing for constitutional change.
